title: Reading — Six Words, Six Lines, and a Whole Meeting
label: ch:gu-pehli-vanchan
canDo: I can read Gujarati off a signboard, read six lines I have only ever said aloud, and follow a whole meeting on the page without translating it word by word.

payoff.summary: The greetings, the repair and the parting the book taught first, read in the order two people would actually use them, with no new word in them.
